julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.title: Julier · Albula · Flüela Graubünden Triangle · part 2
julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.slogan: Julierpass high road to Davos food and weather

waypoints.name: Julierpass high road
waypoints.advice: Julierpass high road is where the day begins. Reckon on about 5 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Albula Pass railway country.

waypoints.name: Albula Pass railway country
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2315 m here. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Flüelapass high section.

waypoints.name: Flüelapass high section
waypoints.advice: 2383 m, and the road stops climbing. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Davos food and weather check, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Davos food and weather check
waypoints.advice: Davos food and weather check closes the day. You lose 823 m on the way down to it, steadily.

sections.advice: Julierpass high road → Albula Pass railway country is 19 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Albula Pass railway country → Flüelapass high section is 26 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Flüelapass high section → Davos food and weather check drops about 823 m over 13 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2383 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.story: A 165 km one-way ride from near Silvaplana, about 3 h 06 of riding. The climbs: Albula Pass railway country and Flüelapass high section. It tops out at 2,383 m. Albula Pass and Fluela Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.
